necessary_differences: Existing migration font-family substitutions to Noto are retained; original geometry/classes/objectNames are compared, not a byte-identical .ui claim.

Relative runtime resource paths use explicit QRC aliases; 17 popup/close PNG assets have identical SHA-256, while arrow_drop_down.svg has one pre-existing trailing LF difference with identical SVG XML.
New embedded mode disables stand-alone horizontal centering and restores original x10/x410 coordinates.

Leaving the account page clears all six transient password edits; committed logout also clears username/row caches and role options while preserving the selected account sub-tab. This is explicit identity cleanup, not a new permission rule.

Manual logout guards both database pages and unsaved hospital edits; actual worker acknowledgement precedes successful logout notification. Pending manual logout locks both main and user-side navigation.
Automatic account-commit or invalidation logout consumes the already-cleared worker snapshot immediately and does not run manual draft confirmation or discard hospital edits.
Original production login modal and its device/query associations remain excluded; CLI --test-session is explicitly an anonymous simulation.
Separate account/hospital worker threads initialize/use/close their own SQL connections; shutdown queues close, then quits and waits both threads. No store implementation change in this round.

O03-2 runtime uses independent data-dir/account and data-dir/hospital with temp/sn100_host/o03_2 builds, separate from O02; wsl run seeds only a new anonymous store with a transient deleted bootstrap file and defaults to Guest.
No role-size global menu/hospital ACL is invented because original user_powers explicit membership is still pending migration.
